description: 台灣電力公司年度線路損失量(率) [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣電力股份有限公司. 本資料集提供輸電系統及配電系統年度及上一年度線路損失量、線路損失率的實績值以及年度差異比較。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣電力股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-07-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
